$sources: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.12, Eq 6.6.104 (part 1 pp. 993-995, gazette pp. 3574-3576): composite concrete flexural members
BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.4.3.5.3, Eq 6.6.55 (part 1 p. 925, gazette p. 3506): least tie area

sources.roughenedLimit: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.12.5.3.1 (p. 994): clean, free of laitance, intentionally roughened: Vnh <= 0.55 bv d
sources.tiedSmoothLimit: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.12.5.3.2 (p. 994): minimum ties, clean, not intentionally roughened: Vnh <= 0.55 bv d
sources.roughenedTied: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.12.5.3.3 (p. 995): ties and a surface roughened to about 6 mm: Vnh = (1.8 + 0.6 ρv fy) λ bv d <= 3.5 bv d; above φ 3.5 bv d shear friction by Sec 6.4.5.4 (6.12.5.3.4)
sources.minTies: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.12.6.1 (p. 995) and Sec 6.4.3.5.3, Eq 6.6.55 (p. 925): Av,min = 0.062 √f'c bw s / fyt, not less than 0.35 bw s / fyt
sources.tieSpacing: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.12.6.1 (p. 995): ties at most four times the least dimension of the supported element and 600 mm apart
sources.tension: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.12.5.5 (p. 995): with tension across the contact surface, shear by contact only with the minimum ties
